quotes.author: Anthony Placzkowski
quotes.text: We came down from Jacksonville, Florida and met other family members from Little Rock, Arkansas and Louisville Kentucky, and decided that it was time for all of us to go check out the swamp. We got a hold of this company and they were very friendly on the phone and even more friendly in person, it was an awesome time we saw gators and a whole bunch of different kinds of birds to include a family of ospreys. An absolute must do. We will do it again.

quotes.author: Samantha Walters
quotes.text: Capt. Mike’s VIP experience was well worth the money. He was very knowledgeable about the local wildlife and knew the best spots to see it all. The scenery is magical and made for an unforgettable experience. When we called to make a reservation, we were hoping for a cooler day. Mike explained that warmer days are better and mid morning to early afternoon is best. We saw so many gators, big and small. I highly recommend for the family.

quotes.author: Norwalk 285
quotes.text: Our group had an amazing outing with Captain Dexter! He was very knowledgeable about the habitats we saw, and did a great job educating us on the history of the area, the wildlife, etc. We saw gators and a bunch of other fish and animals. The boat ride was a blast! Highly recommended!!

quotes.author: Jerry Van Dyke
quotes.text: Captain Mike was GREAT! His boat driving, the informative / educational tour stops and talks and the overall experience were great for everyone from grandsons to grandma! We had hoped to see a few alligators, and we saw nearly 200! Loved it!!

quotes.author: Patti Voskuil
quotes.text: Outstanding experience, Capt. Dex was as informative as entertaining (as perfect epitome of Florida as I am of Wisconsin). Myself and family will have many great memories, if you're considering--just do it, you won't be disappointed.

quotes.author: Sarah Meenan
quotes.text: This was such a cool experience! Captain Dexter made it fun for both the kids and adults. He was very informative about the wildlife and the area. We learned a ton and saw a different animals which was great!!
